moments.title: 75% of VC money still hides in 3 cities
moments.insight: Mary Grove notes 75% of venture capital still flows to just Silicon Valley, New York, and Boston, leaving every other market 'emerging.'

moments.title: The 19-partner circle unlocking Midwest deals
moments.insight: Bread & Butter built a formal 'Innovation Circle' of 19 Fortune 500 partners feeding real-time industry insight into their deal flow.

moments.title: How a hospital partner resurfaced a hot deal
moments.insight: A health system that had used Qrounds internally for two years reintroduced the founder to Bread & Butter, leading them to lead its seed round.

moments.title: "We are in an AI bubble" — but not near the peak
moments.insight: Grove states plainly she believes we're in an AI bubble, yet argues it's still far from its peak and every company must know where it sits on the AI continuum.

moments.title: AI in healthcare: the most important use of our lifetime
moments.insight: She calls AI applications in healthcare potentially 'the most important applications of our lifetime,' while stressing caution since patient lives are at stake.

moments.title: Breast cancer AI trained on data that finally includes her
moments.insight: Portfolio company Gabby built its breast cancer risk algorithm on the most diverse dataset ever, unlike prior models not trained on people who look like her.
